title: launch-governance-checklist-and-economic-swingbook
summary: Compact operational ledger combining launch governance checkpoints with a lightweight KPI watchlist and economic levers. Designed for cross-functional daily standups during the 4-week ramp window. Prioritizes metrics that unlock capacity, cost headroom, and rollback triggers rather than exhaustive telemetry.
kpi_headers: KPI, Target (SLO/Value), Current, Owner, Trigger (actionable), Contingency
kpi_rows: Token/sec throughput, 100k tokens/s sustained, 12k tokens/s, Marco Nguyen, sustained >80% of target for 30m, enable burst nodes + degrade to latencystable model
Median gen latency (95p), <300ms, 420ms, Elena Rossi, >350ms for 10m, reduce batch size + route to faster quantized model
Error rate (5xx + model misfires), <0.2%, 0.9%, Samir Desai, >0.5% rolling 5m, escalate to SRE + traffic holdback
Cost per 1k tokens (USD), <=$0.18, $0.23, Priya Kapoor, >$0.20 for 24h, enable caching and lower-precision variant for non-critical routes
Adopter success rate (beta cohort), 90% tasks successful, 84%, Asha Patel, <85% for a week, open expert-support trenches + rollback change set
Canary conversion delta, <=2% uplift variance, 5.8% negative delta, Marco Nguyen, negative >3% in 2 runs, revert canary + postmortem
readiness_checklist: Infra: burst pool validated for region-us-west-2 and region-eu-central-1
Security: KMS key rotation and audit export for private deploys completed
SLOs: SLA wording approved by legal and sales; latency SLOs mapped to error budgets
Rollout: canary traffic plan and percentage timeline (1%, 5%, 25%, 100%) documented
Monitoring: alert thresholds in alerting-config repo set and noise suppression tested
Fallbacks: pre-approved fallback models and region routing policies listed
Support: oncall rotation assigned with runbook links and escalation matrix
Data contracts: user data retention + telemetry sampling defined for compliance
Customer comms: beta release notes + support playbook drafted and reviewed
